description: Enqueue an autonomous verification job for a task completion (Verification Layer V2 + V7 doc_check, POST /completions/:completion_id/verification-jobs): http_probe checks a URL (params url, and optionally expect_status, expect_content_type, expect_sha256), doc_check runs a named policy against params.url and params.policy_id. Read the result with tascan_list_verifications once the job runs. Write tier.

params.description: For http_probe: url, and optionally expect_status, expect_content_type, expect_sha256. For doc_check: url and policy_id, where policy_id names an active doc_check policy.

run_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp to schedule the job for (default now).

name: tascan_request_verification
